basic_details.job_title: IIT Kanpur Research Associate I (Chemical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Chemical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, is recruiting a Research Associate-I for the Indo-Taiwan sponsored project "Novel Molten Catalyst for Dry Reforming of Methane: Experiments and Modeling". The post carries a consolidated salary of Rs 58,000 per month plus HRA (as per institute norms) for one year from 1 December 2026. A PhD is the essential qualification. Applications are submitted through a Google Form, and the last date is 20 November 2026.

qualification.details: PhD in Chemical Engineering/Chemistry/Physics/Material Science or related disciplines with strong fundamentals in Catalysis. Prior experience with density functional theory calculations (preferably in VASP, CP2K) and machine learning. Good programming knowledge in C/C++ (or fortran), Linux shell scripting. Familiarity with HPC environment. Extensive experience with coding in C/C++ (or fortran or python) and familiarity with Linux environment is a must.

how_to_apply: Applications are to be submitted by filling the Google Form given in the notice, on or before 20 November 2026. The form link is on the Important Links table below. The notice asks that applications not be sent to the email address of Dr. Vishal Agarwal, which is given only for further queries.
Copies of relevant certificates, required if the candidate is shortlisted.
Original certificates, against which the copies are checked at the time of interview.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. For further details, applicants may contact Dr. Vishal Agarwal, Department of Chemical Engineering, at [email protected] or +91 512 259 6895. The department's address is Department of Chemical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh-208016, India.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kanpur Research Associate-I at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur (IIT Kanpur)

Department of Chemical Engineering, IIT Kanpur, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: PhD in Chemical Engineering/Chemistry/Physics/Material Science or related disciplines with strong fundamentals in Catalysis. Prior experience with density functional theory calculations (preferably in VASP, CP2K) and machine learning. Good programming knowledge in C/C++ (or fortran), Linux shell scripting. Familiarity with HPC environment. Extensive experience with coding in C/C++ (or fortran or python) and familiarity with Linux environment is a must. Prior research experience in molten catalysis would be considered an added advantage. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated salary is Rs 58,000/- per month plus HRA (as per institute norms). The post is for one year, starting from 1 December 2026. The notice states that the appointment is purely temporary and on contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kanpur Research Associate-I Job Description
content_sections.text: The successful candidate would be the key person in driving the project along with the PI. The candidate should assist the PI running the laboratory and guiding the research of PhD students.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kanpur Research Associate-I
content_sections.text: Applications are to be submitted by filling the Google Form given in the notice, on or before 20 November 2026. The form link is on the Important Links table below. The notice asks that applications not be sent to the email address of Dr. Vishal Agarwal, which is given only for further queries. Copies of relevant certificates, required if the candidate is shortlisted. Original certificates, against which the copies are checked at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection committee approved by IIT Kanpur reserves the right to fix suitable criteria for shortlisting eligible candidates who satisfy the qualifications, experience and the recommendations. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, which will be held online. The date of the interview is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. For further details, applicants may contact Dr. Vishal Agarwal, Department of Chemical Engineering, at [email protected] or +91 512 259 6895. The department's address is Department of Chemical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh-208016, India.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Kanpur Research Associate-I?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications is 20 November 2026, through the Google Form given in the notice.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for IIT Kanpur Research Associate-I?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a PhD in Chemical Engineering/Chemistry/Physics/Material Science or related disciplines with strong fundamentals in Catalysis. Extensive coding experience in C/C++ (or fortran or python) and familiarity with Linux is a must.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of IIT Kanpur Research Associate-I?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs 58,000/- per month plus HRA (as per institute norms).

faq.question: Q4. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs 58,000 salary?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states the consolidated salary as Rs 58,000/- per month plus HRA (as per institute norms).

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the IIT Kanpur Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Fill in the Google Form linked in the notice on or before 20 November 2026. Do not send the application to Dr. Vishal Agarwal's email address, which is meant only for further details.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The selection committee shortlists eligible candidates on qualifications, experience and recommendations. Only shortlisted candidates are called for an online interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is the IIT Kanpur Research Associate-I post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the appointment is purely temporary and on contractual basis, for one year starting from 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, according to the notice.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are needed after shortlisting?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates need copies of relevant certificates, which are checked against the original certificates at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q10. What will the Research Associate-I do?
faq.answer: The selected candidate would be the key person driving the project along with the PI. The candidate should also assist the PI in running the laboratory and guiding the research of PhD students.
